verdict.rationale: Evidence shows QuickBooks Online has a documented REST API with OAuth client, PHP SDK, and an official MCP server claiming 'complete coverage' (145 tools) of the QBO API, implying report/ledger data can be pulled programmatically. However, there is no direct evidence citing General Ledger or Trial Balance endpoints specifically, and probes show no public OpenAPI/llms.txt spec (404s), undermining the 'open formats' documentation claim.
